'''''Darth-Nemo-Dak''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] of ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore that was part of a [[Darth Wyyrlok's library|collection]] owned by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], [[Loremaster|Master of Sith Lore]] of the [[One Sith]] order. The collection could be found in the order's [[Temple of the Sith]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the capital of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Legacy 27" />

The book's outer cover was a gray-brown [[Color/Legends|color]] and featured the title on its spine, which was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters. Additional text was also present toward the bottom of the spine.<ref name="Legacy 27" />

In [[137 ABY]], Darth Wyyrlok searched through his collection in order to find a cure for a [[Death/Legends|terminal]] affliction suffered by his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Darth Krayt]]. ''Darth-Nemo-Dak'' was present in a pile of books nearby as Wyyrlok was engaged in his search.<ref name="Legacy 27" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Darth-Nemo-Dak'' appeared a flashback in the background of a comic panel in the [[Legacy (2006) 27|twenty-seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' from publisher [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="Legacy 27" /> The issue was published on [[August 27]], [[2008]]<ref name="Release Date">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/15-530/Star-Wars-Legacy-27|text=Star Wars: Legacy #27}}</ref> and was written by [[John Ostrander]] with illustrations by [[Omar Francia]] and [[Brad Anderson]].<ref name="Legacy 27" />

''Darth-Nemo-Dak'' is placed toward the far-right side of a comic panel, and as such, part of the book's spine is cut off from view. To the right of the title, partially illegible additional text is visible, reading "discov&ndash;."<ref name="Legacy 27" />
